steps.name: Sincronizar as stories
steps.task: Call sync_github on ibid-langgraph. It brings every issue linked to a story in line with where the story stands. Hand back its one-line result per story and whether everything is up to date.

steps.name: Rever todas as issues
steps.task: List every open issue of each repository named in the request with gh. For each one, compare it with the stories of the flow engine, the backlog (read_backlog), the git log of the default branch and the code. Decide one action per issue: keep; fix its labels, size, parent or body to match what was approved; close as completed with the evidence (commit or story); close as duplicate of the issue it repeats; or close as not planned when it no longer makes sense. Hand back one finding per issue that needs an action: "#<n>: <action> — <reason and evidence>".

steps.name: Corrigir o GitHub
steps.task: Apply every finding with gh: edit labels, size, parent and body; close with the reason (completed, duplicate, not planned) and a short comment in English that gives the evidence. Close an epic whose sub-issues are all closed. Never delete an issue. Hand back what changed, the links of the issues you closed, and a one-line summary that says whether GitHub now matches the real state.
